session_1.speaker: Jiaqi
session_1.text: I'm moving to Hangzhou next week, job transfer.

session_1.speaker: Assistant
session_1.text: That's a big change. Have you found a place yet?

session_1.speaker: Jiaqi
session_1.text: Yes, in Xihu District, a fifteen-minute bike ride from the office.

session_1.speaker: Jiaqi
session_1.text: I have a British Shorthair named Momo, bringing him along too.

session_2.speaker: Jiaqi
session_2.text: It's been over a month since the move, and Momo settled in faster than me.

session_2.speaker: Jiaqi
session_2.text: Not bad, the new team just moves fast. I worked overtime three days in a row last week.

session_1.text: I'm vegetarian, and I'm allergic to nuts.

session_1.speaker: Assistant
session_1.text: Got it, I'll avoid both when suggesting food.
